commands.review_summary:
Adds Control UI support for creating labeled dashboard sessions with `/new --name <title>`, adopts the returned session route before list refresh, restores failed asynchronous command drafts, and documents and tests the behavior.

PR surface: Source +70, Tests +202, Docs +3. Total +275 across 10 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the introduced patch defect: the exact-head adapter converts the send promise to `void`, while the new composer recovery logic requires that promise to run its final draft synchronization. The requested named-session capability itself is a feature, not a pre-existing bug reproduction.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow mechanical promise-forwarding repair is clearly defined; once applied and proven, the remaining step is owner approval of the public command grammar.

target.title: feat(ui): start named sessions with /new --name
target.body:
<!--
Optional linked context:
Add a visible `Closes #<issue-number>` or `Related: #<issue-number>` line
below this comment.

Required PR title:
type: user-facing description
Use a parenthesized scope only when it adds clarity:
fix(auth): login redirect loops when session cookie is expired

Types: feat, fix, improve, refactor, docs, chore.
For fixes, describe the user-visible symptom and trigger:
fix: task list fails to load when user has no environments
Avoid implementation details such as:
fix: add null check to task query
-->

Closes #93422

<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

**MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers
can help update the branch when needed.

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

Control UI users can create a fresh dashboard session with typed `/new`, but
there is no unambiguous way to give that new session a recognizable name. An
implicit `/new <text>` naming rule would also conflict with the model-oriented
meaning that `/new` arguments have on other chat surfaces.

A successful create could additionally finish persisting and listing the new
session without switching the active Control UI route when the list refresh
replaced the initiating chat pane.

## Why This Change Was Made

Control UI now recognizes only the explicit `/new --name <title>` form for
new-session naming. Bare `/new` and every other `/new <text>` form retain the
existing anonymous dashboard-session behavior, while `/name <title>` remains
the shared rename command and other surfaces keep their existing `/new`
semantics.

This is a root-cause repair at the typed-command parsing and pane-lifecycle
ownership boundaries. The name continues through the existing validated
`sessions.create.label` path. The returned session key is handed to the
originating pane before the forced session-list refresh publishes, so
refresh-driven lifecycle changes cannot discard a successful route switch.
This adds no Gateway field, schema, permission, persistence, model-routing, or
non-Control-UI behavior.

## User Impact

Control UI users can type `/new --name Research Plan` or
`/new --name "Research Plan"` to create, select, and visibly label a fresh
dashboard session. Existing `/new` usage remains compatible and anonymous
unless the explicit `--name` option is present.

If creation cannot safely switch the route, the typed command is restored in
the composer instead of disappearing as if it succeeded.

## Evidence

- Exact-head browser proof used commit
  `25083b59e15a264352a5743e55a8ef235f5d7a57`, a production Control UI build,
  and a real isolated Gateway. It exercised the malformed, explicit-name,
  bare, and arbitrary-text forms and inspected the session registry, returned
  metadata, URL, ChatPane state, selected session state, and active sidebar
  row.

  ```text
  gatewayReady=true productionUiBuild=true
  malformed=/new --name sessions=1->1 usageVisible=true composerRestored=true
  command=/new --name "Strong E2E Proof"
  namedCreatedExactlyOne=true label="Strong E2E Proof" displayName="Strong E2E Proof"
  returnedKey==urlSession==paneKey==stateSession==activeSidebarKey=true
  bareNew: createdExactlyOne=true label=null active="New session"
  /new Legacy Text: createdExactlyOne=true label=null active="New session"
  allRuntimeAssertions=true
  ```

- The run captured the malformed-command state and before/after Control UI
  states. The exact-head assertions confirm the visible active sidebar name,
  route adoption, metadata, and anonymous compatibility behavior rather than
  only Gateway readiness.
- Parser coverage: an earlier PR revision forwarded the literal label
  `--name Research Plan`; the focused tests now prove `Research Plan` is
  forwarded instead, including the quoted form, malformed `--name` usage
  errors, and anonymous compatibility for `/new Research Plan`.
- TDD lifecycle regression: before the repair, a successful `sessions.create`
  followed by a list-refresh pane retirement returned `false` and never called
  `onPaneSessionChange`; the regression now proves the returned key is handed
  to navigation before that refresh.
- TDD composer and initial-route regressions cover visible async command
  restoration and startup ownership before a newly created session adopts its
  returned key.
- Affected UI tests: 410 passed across `chat-send.test.ts`,
  `chat-view.test.ts`, `chat-pane.test.ts`, and `lib/sessions/index.test.ts`.
- Focused formatting passed, UI test types passed, and the production Control
  UI build passed.
- The public proof addresses the current-head inspectability request. The
  compatibility boundary remains intentionally narrow: only explicit
  `--name` opts into naming, arbitrary text remains anonymous, and accepting
  this Control UI-specific option remains a maintainer product decision.
